metadata.title: The Dealmaking 3: Madden’s AI Persona Engine, Boehly’s $75B AI Bet & Pac-12 Free on YouTube

content.text:
This week of The Dealmaking 3 with "The Sports Professor" Rick Horrow features Madden NFL 27 launching a new Persona Engine with more than 65 behavioral DNA types for every player, Todd Boehly's Eldridge, a $75 billion asset manager, deploying AI across over 100 portfolio companies including Chelsea FC, and Pac-12 moving its fall Olympic sports, soccer and volleyball to free streaming on YouTube.
